body:
October 27, 2025

The production release took place after 12:00 p.m. CDT, 10/27/2025.

# Enhancements

### Radius Search

Now, radius searches of providers within multiple zip codes will be based on a true radius calculation instead of a centroid zip radius within Compare Networks, Competitive Dashboard, Create a List, and Create a Directory features.  This enhancement also resolved time-out issues in Recruitment.



### Manage Users

Now, External Admin users can export the activity count information with the Users list export.  The new “Activity Count” column displays the count of the user’s activities within the last 12 months.  



### Look up a Provider

Now when the user searches for a facility name where the project data includes multiple locations with the same name, the user will see only one instance of the name in the type-ahead dropdown list.  When the user selects that name, the user will see a results list instead of the provider’s profile page. The user can view desired Provider Profile page by clicking on the location within the results list. 



# Fixes

### Competitive Dashboard

Fixed an issue where the analysis utilized the previously selected specialty mapping to determine the results. Now, the results utilize the currently selected specialty mapping.  



### Accessibility

Now, the exported Access Details by Zip Code CSV report displays data for all selected specialties instead of the results for only the first selected specialty.

Fixed an issue where a link in the broker client user’s email notification was not pointing to the custom subdomain. Now, the link points to the correct subdomain.

### Model Networks

Now, when the Find Providers criteria includes a Datetime or Claim Verified Location attribute, the expected results appear correctly. 

### Manage Users

Fixed an issue where the project selections for a newly created user do not display initially.  Now, the selections are displayed correctly. 

### Help Center

Fixed an issue where the navigations within the Help Center were not working correctly. Now, users can navigate within the Help Center using the Help Center’s left navigation menu.
shortDescription: This Network360 release includes a new exciting performance enhancement where multiple zip codes radius searches are now based on a true radius search instead of our prior methodology (centroid radius search).  This new methodology is incorporated in Compare Networks, Competitive Dashboard, Create a List, and Create a Directory features.  Other enhancements include enabling all Admin users to view the users’ activities count for the last 12 months within the Users list export in Manage Users and de-duplication of facility names in Look up a Provider.
